title: Taking a job at the munitions plant
summary: Thinking her career over, she drove elderly women to bingo. One drove her to a munitions plant and talked her into the hiring line, and she got the job after a doctor's check and a strike.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: So really at that time you thought your career was over, didn't you?

Yes. And at night time I used to take alot of the elderly ladies to the bingo games, you know. They'd call me and ask me if I'd drive them and I said, yes. So one day a lady wanted me to take her out to a place called The Bag Plant , it was munition's plant, you know, and so I said, "alright, I'll take you in the morning. So I took her out there. She said, "why don't you get in line?" I said, "I don't know anything about making bullets.". And she said, "yeah, but they teach you". And I said, "no". And she said, "Come on and get in line. You don't know what will happen". So I got in the line. So they hired me and the didn't

Then I had to go and see the doctor.

So I went to see the doctor and he said I'd have to lose a little weight. And so I lost a little weight and then they had a strike and we didn't have to go back for a long time. But then that girl called me up again, 'come on, they opened up and the strike is over. Come on'. I said, 'Oh I forgot about that thing'. She said, 'Oh come one, let's go'. And I went on out there and she said, 'why don't you go in there and ask them what happened?' And I went on in there and the lady said go on down and get your note from the doctor. So I went down there and got the thing from the doctor and came on back and I was hired.
